body: WELCOME TO QUANTUM BOX.
INSIDE, YOU WILL FIND THE FUTURE OF ENTERTAINMENT.

FIVE GAMES
FIVE EXPERIENCES
FIVE WAYS TO PLAY WITH THE POWER OF QUANTUM COMPUTING.

THANK YOU FOR TAKING THE TIME TO
REVIEW THIS PRODUCT DEMONSTRATION.

I KNOW WHAT YOU’RE THINKING:
QUANTUM COMPUTERS HAVE BEEN BUILT FOR SERIOUS WORK.

SCIENCE
INDUSTRY
SIMULATION
OPTIMIZATION
ISN’T IT A BIT SILLY TO USE THEM TO PLAY GAMES?

BUT IT WAS PLAY, NOT WORK, THAT TURNED MAINFRAME
MONOLITHS INTO CONSUMER PRODUCTS.

HIPPIES HACKING SPACEWAR! MADE COMPUTERS COOL.
ARCADES DEMANDING COINS MADE COMPUTERS COMMERCIAL.
CONSOLES COMING HOME MADE COMPUTERS PART OF LIFE.

THE VIDEO GAME MADE CLASSICAL COMPUTING PERSONAL.
IT’S TIME FOR QUANTUM TO HAVE ITS MAGNAVOX ODYSSEY MOMENT.
LET'S START WITH SOMETHING EVERYONE KNOWS.

PONG HAS A BALL,
TWO PADDLES,
AND TWO GOALS.
I'VE CHANGED ONE THING (OTHER THAN THE FIRST LETTER).
THE QUANTUM COMPUTER DECIDES WHAT A GOAL MEANS.
EACH ROUND USES ONE OF TWO RULES.

OPPOSITE:
SCORE THROUGH THE OTHER GOAL.

OWN:
SCORE THROUGH YOUR OWN GOAL.
THE RULE BEGINS UNRESOLVED.
PRESS ACTION TO OBSERVE THE RULE.

YOU GET THREE OBSERVATIONS
ACROSS SEVEN ROUNDS.

OTHERWISE, YOU'LL HAVE TO WAIT FOR
A GOAL TO FIND OUT WHO SCORED.
TRY THAT AGAIN.

OPPOSITE:
SCORE THROUGH THE OTHER GOAL.

OWN:
SCORE THROUGH YOUR OWN GOAL.
PRESS ACTION TO OBSERVE THE RULE.

THREE OBSERVATIONS
ACROSS SEVEN ROUNDS.
ALRIGHT, YOU GET THE IDEA.
WELL DONE.

THE BALL CAN CROSS A LINE
BEFORE YOU KNOW
WHAT THAT CROSSING MEANS.

TWO POSSIBLE OUTCOMES.
EACH EQUALLY LIKELY.

ONLY WHEN THE QUBIT
IS MEASURED
DO YOU FIND OUT
WHAT HAPPENED.

THINK WHAT YOU COULD DO
WITH THAT.
YES, I KNOW.

IT SOUNDS JUST LIKE
A COIN TOSS.

BUT THIS IS TRUE RANDOMNESS!
QRNG™ (QUANTUM RANDOM NUMBER GENERATION)!

BESIDES,
I HAVE SOME MORE THINGS
TO SHOW YOU.
SKIPIXL ................. LOADING

ONE QUANTUM RESULT
CAN DECIDE AN OUTCOME.
BUT WHY STOP THERE?

THE QPIXL ENGINE RETURNS
A WHOLE FIELD OF VALUES.

ENOUGH TO BUILD
THE WORLD YOU CAN PLAY IN.
SO I MADE A SKI SLOPE.

GET TO THE BOTTOM
BEFORE THE TIMER RUNS OUT.
PASS THROUGH THE GATES.

LEFT / RIGHT:
TURN.

DOWN:
GO FASTER.
YOU HAVE 60 SECONDS.

I STARTED WITH A GRID OF PIXEL VALUES.
I SENT IT THROUGH THE QUANTUM COMPUTER.

WHAT CAME BACK WASN’T QUITE WHAT WENT IN.
SO I TOOK THE DIFFERENCE.

WHERE THE VALUES CHANGED MOST,
I PUT SOMETHING IN YOUR WAY.

TREES.
MOGULS.
THEN I SET A COURSE THROUGH THEM.

QTG™!
(QUANTUM TERRAIN GENERATION).
THAT WAS THE SENSIBLE VERSION.

THEN I WONDERED
WHAT WOULD HAPPEN
IF I USED MORE OF THE FIELD.
QUITE A LOT MORE.
SAME RULES.
GET TO THE BOTTOM.
PASS THROUGH THE GATES.

LEFT / RIGHT:
TURN.

DOWN:
GO FASTER.
60 SECONDS.
YOU ACTUALLY MADE IT.
I'M IMPRESSED.
WAS IT... ENJOYABLE?
SORRY.

I MAY HAVE PUSHED
THAT ONE
A LITTLE TOO FAR.

OBVIOUSLY,
THIS IS JUST AN EXPERIMENT.

I DON'T ACTUALLY THINK
THE BEST USE OF QPIXL
IS FILLING A SKI SLOPE
WITH TREES.

IT'S MUCH BETTER
WITH IMAGES.

IN FACT,
THE BACKGROUND YOU'VE BEEN
LOOKING AT THIS WHOLE TIME
IS BUILT FROM QPIXL DATA.

YOU CAN SEE MORE
IN SETTINGS.
THEY’RE RATHER IMPRESSIVE.
RIGHT?
QUANTMAN ............... LOADING

WITH SKIPIXL, THE QUANTUM DATA
BUILT THE COURSE BEFORE YOU ARRIVED.
HOWEVER SURPRISING IT WAS, THE LEVEL STAYED THE SAME.
AND NOTHING YOU DID COULD CHANGE HOW IT WORKED.

QUANTMAN IS DIFFERENT.
THE LEVEL CHANGES WHILE YOU'RE INSIDE IT.
AND WHAT YOU DO CHANGES THE LEVEL.
CLEAR THE MAZE.

EAT THE DOTS.
AVOID THE GHOSTS.

WHAT YOU FACE
STAYS AS IT IS.

LOOK AWAY
AND IT MIGHT NOT STAY.

USE YOUR GAZE
TO HOLD A ROUTE OPEN
OR KEEP A WALL CLOSED.
TRY IT AGAIN.

DON'T JUST REMEMBER
THE MAZE.

MANAGE IT
WITH YOUR GAZE.
ALRIGHT.
I THINK YOU GET THE IDEA.
WELL DONE.

If YOU THINK ABOUT IT,
A MAZE IS REALLY
A PATTERN OF CONNECTIONS.
THIS SPACE LEADS TO THAT ONE.
THAT ONE DOESN’T LEAD TO THIS SPACE.

CHANGE THE CONNECTIONS
AND YOU CHANGE THE MAZE.

IN QUANTMAN,
EACH OF 100 SPATIAL UNITS CORRESPONDS
TO A QUBIT (QUANTUM BIT)
IN A MEASURED PATTERN, EACH SPACE GETS A 0 OR 1.

MATCHING NEIGHBOURS = PASSAGE.
DIFFERENT NEIGHBOURS = WALL.
ONE PATTERN GIVES A COMPLETE MAZE.

DURING PLAY,
THE GAME KEEPS CYCLING
THROUGH THOSE CONFIGURATIONS.

YOUR GAZE SETS
A CONDITION:

WHATEVER COMES NEXT,
WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING AT
HAS TO STAY THE SAME.

MAYBE QUANTUM COMPUTING
DOESN'T JUST GIVE US
NEW THINGS TO PLAY WITH.

MAYBE IT GIVES US
NEW ROLES TO PLAY.

IN QUANTMAN,
YOU PLAY THE OBSERVER.
QRP™!
QUANTUM ROLEPLAY!
FLUXBALL ................ LOADING

USUALLY, WHEN YOU START A GAME,
YOU KNOW THE RULES.

WHAT YOU DON'T KNOW
IS HOW IT WILL END.

BUT WHAT IF THE RULES
WERE UNCERTAIN TOO?
NOT JUST WHO WINS.

HOW YOU MOVE.
WHAT YOU CAN DO.
WHAT COUNTS AS WINNING.
GAMES ARE MADE OF RULES.

CHANGE THE RULES
AND YOU CHANGE THE GAME.
SO LET'S TRY GENERATING THOSE.

I'VE STARTED WITH SOMETHING SIMPLE:
TWO PLAYERS AND A BALL.
YOU BOTH PLAY BY THE SAME RULES.

I JUST HAVEN'T TOLD YOU
WHAT THEY ARE.

MOVE:
DIRECT OR INVERTED.

TOUCH THE BALL:
CARRY IT OR STRIKE IT.

SCORE:
THROUGH THE OPPOSITE GOAL
OR YOUR OWN.

TEST WHAT WORKS.
WATCH WHAT HAPPENS.
PRESS ACTION TO CHANGE THE RULES.

ONE CHANGE PER ROUND.
SHARED BETWEEN BOTH PLAYERS.
FIRST TO PRESS USES IT.

THREE 40-SECOND ROUNDS.
WIN MORE ROUNDS TO WIN THE MATCH.
WELL DONE.

SHALL WE MAKE IT
MORE INTERESTING?
ANOTHER GO?

OR SHALL WE MAKE THINGS
A LITTLE MORE INTERESTING?

SO FAR, ONE RULEBOOK.
BOTH PLAYERS FOLLOW IT.
BUT WHY SHOULD THEY?

WHAT IF YOU COULD CARRY THE BALL,
WHILE I COULD ONLY STRIKE IT?

WHAT IF THE GOAL THAT SCORED FOR YOU
ALSO SCORED FOR ME?

SAME BALL.
SAME FIELD.
DIFFERENT GAMES.

NOW EACH PLAYER HAS THEIR OWN
MOVEMENT, BALL AND SCORING RULES.

WHAT WORKS FOR THE OTHER PLAYER
MAY NOT WORK FOR YOU.
FIND OUT BY PLAYING.

WATCH YOUR SCORE:
A GOAL CAN BENEFIT BOTH OF YOU.
ACTION CHANGES BOTH PLAYERS' RULES.
ONE SHARED CHANGE PER ROUND.

SAME MATCH:
THREE 40-SECOND ROUNDS.
WELL DONE.

LET ME SHOW YOU
HOW I PUT THAT TOGETHER.
WE CAN TRY THAT AGAIN.

OR I CAN SHOW YOU
HOW I PUT IT TOGETHER.

YOU WERE SHARING A WORLD
WITHOUT NECESSARILY
PLAYING THE SAME GAME.

I USED THE QUANTUM GRAPH ENGINE
TO RECORD MEASUREMENT RESULTS
FOR BOTH PLAYERS TOGETHER.

EACH RESULT CONTAINS
A VALUE FOR EACH PLAYER.

THE GAME DRAWS WHOLE PAIRS
FROM THOSE RECORDED DISTRIBUTIONS.

ONE PAIR FOR MOVEMENT.
ONE FOR THE BALL.
ONE FOR SCORING.

IN THE FIRST VERSION,
I COMBINED EACH PAIR
INTO A RULE YOU BOTH FOLLOWED.

IN THE SECOND,
EACH PLAYER GOT THEIR OWN
PART OF THE PAIR.
I STILL WROTE THE POSSIBLE RULES.

THE QUANTUM RESULTS DETERMINE
HOW THEY'RE COMBINED
AND DISTRIBUTED BETWEEN PLAYERS.

I CALL THIS QGG™!
QUANTUM GAME GENERATION.
THIS BALL GAME IS JUST THE START.
IMAGINE THE POSSIBILITIES!
QUARRY ................. LOADING
ONE LAST GAME.

IN FLUXBALL,
WE CHANGED THE RULES
BETWEEN PLAYERS.

NOW LET'S CHANGE
WHAT THEY ARE
TO ONE ANOTHER.

SOMEONE CHASES.
SOMEONE IS CHASED.
I TRIED IT WITH DUCKS.

LEFT / RIGHT:
MOVE.

ACTION:
FLAP.

WATCH WHO YOU HUNT
AND WHO HUNTS YOU.

CATCH YOUR QUARRY
FROM ABOVE TO SCORE.

KEEP YOUR HUNTERS
FROM GETTING ABOVE YOU.

THE RELATIONSHIPS CHANGE
EVERY 12 SECONDS.

YOU CAN BE SOMEONE'S HUNTER
AND SOMEONE ELSE'S QUARRY
AT THE SAME TIME.
THREE 60-SECOND ROUNDS.
EACH CATCH EARNS A POINT.

MOST POINTS IN A ROUND
EARNS ONE ROUND WIN.

TIED LEADERS
EACH EARN A WIN.

POINTS RESET.
ROUND WINS STAY.

WIN THE MOST ROUNDS
TO WIN THE MATCH.
WELL DONE.

ONE MORE THING
ABOUT THE DUCKS.
ANOTHER GO?

OR SHALL I EXPLAIN
THE DUCKS?
REMEMBER QUANTMAN?

WE COMPARED NEIGHBOURING BITS
TO MAKE PASSAGES AND WALLS.

HERE, EACH BIT STANDS
FOR A RELATIONSHIP.

FOUR DUCKS.
TWELVE POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS
OF PURSUIT.

A HUNTS B.
B HUNTS A.
TWO DIFFERENT BITS.

1: THE LINK IS ON.
0: THE LINK IS OFF.

I USED THE QUANTUM GRAPH ENGINE
TO RECORD TWELVE-BIT
MEASUREMENT RESULTS.

EACH RESULT DEFINES
A WHOLE PATTERN OF PURSUIT.

THE GAME DRAWS FROM
THOSE RECORDED PATTERNS,
WEIGHTED BY HOW OFTEN
THEY APPEARED.

NOT A SEPARATE DRAW
FOR EVERY DUCK.

ONE PATTERN THAT DETERMINES
WHO HUNTS WHOM.

A HUNTS B.
C HUNTS A.

A IS BOTH
HUNTER AND QUARRY.

I DIDN'T ASSIGN A ROLE
AND THEN FIND IT A RELATIONSHIP.

THE RELATIONSHIPS
DETERMINE THE ROLE.

THE RELATIONS
DETERMINE THE RELATA.

QRG™!
QUANTUM ROLE GENERATION.
NOT JUST WHAT YOU CAN DO.

WHAT YOU ARE
TO ONE ANOTHER.
FIVE GAMES.

I HOPE YOU CAN SEE
MORE THAN FIVE GAMES HERE.

AN OPPORTUNITY
TO MAKE QUANTUM COMPUTING
PERSONAL.

A WHOLE NEW MARKET
FOR A WHOLE NEW KIND
OF ENTERTAINMENT.

QUANTUM BOX
IN HOMES ALL OVER THE WORLD.

OF APPROXIMATELY [REDACTED]

MOST OF THAT WILL GO TOWARDS
ACQUIRING THE QUANTUM DATA
THAT POWERS THE GAMES.

ONCE WE HAVE THAT PIPELINE
IN PLACE,
WE CAN BUILD ON IT.

MORE GAMES.
OTHER APPLICATIONS.
A PLATFORM FOR QUANTUM CREATIVITY
THANK YOU FOR YOUR TIME.
YOU CAN CONTACT ME AT [REDACTED]

I LOOK FORWARD
TO DISCUSSING
THE NEXT STEPS.
QBOX> END DEMO
